mergedParams.userDescription: Aggressive, fast-cutting text with rough, shaky textures. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Aggressive Fast-Cut Typo Kinetics with Shaky Textures

prompts.prompt: Create an aggressive typokinetics preset that mimics the raw, unpolished aesthetic of 90s skateboarding videos and punk rock flyers. The text should appear to be violently shaking and glitching, as if being physically attacked or damaged. Think of each word as if it's being hit by invisible hammers - sudden jarring movements, rapid vibrations, and unpredictable position shifts. The animation should feel dangerous and unstable, with text that seems to be fighting against its container. Use a combination of rapid translateX/Y oscillations with varying amplitudes, sudden scale jumps, and intermittent rotation jerks. The text should occasionally 'break free' from its position with explosive movements before snapping back. Layer multiple shake effects with different frequencies - a base tremor at 60Hz, mid-range wobble at 15Hz, and violent jerks at random intervals. Add visual texture through rapidly changing text-shadow values that create a motion blur effect, and use filter blur/brightness oscillations to simulate camera shake. The overall effect should feel like watching text through a handheld camera during an earthquake.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use BaseLayout with absolute positioning for each TextAtom word. Set containerProps.className='relative overflow-hidden' to contain explosive movements. Each word gets its own TextAtom with position:'absolute' and random initial offsets. Effects: Create a custom shake effect using generic keyframe animations with multiple AnimationRange arrays - one for translateX (range: -20 to 20, easing: 'linear', 8 keyframes), one for translateY (range: -15 to 15, easing: 'linear', 6 keyframes), one for rotate (range: -5 to 5 degrees, random easing per keyframe). Add a secondary high-frequency vibration effect with translateX/Y ranges of -3 to 3 pixels at 0.05s intervals. Use filter effects with blur oscillating between 0 and 2px, brightness between 0.8 and 1.2. Timing: Each word starts at relative time 0 but with staggered effect start times (0.1s increments). Duration should be 2-3x the caption duration to allow for continuous shaking. Performance: Use transform: translateZ(0) on each TextAtom to force GPU acceleration. Limit blur effects to critical moments. Use will-change: transform on active elements. Tailwind: 'font-black text-6xl md:text-8xl text-white mix-blend-difference'

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-heavy typokinetics preset inspired by corrupted VHS tapes and digital signal interference. The text should stutter and slice horizontally, creating the impression of tracking errors and data corruption. Imagine the text as if it's being transmitted through a damaged cable - occasional perfect clarity interrupted by violent horizontal tears, RGB channel separation, and temporal displacement. Words should randomly duplicate, offset, and overlap themselves, creating ghost images. Implement scan line effects where portions of text appear to be shifted horizontally at different rates, simulating analog video distortion. Add chromatic aberration by splitting the text into RGB channels that separate and rejoin. Include 'hold frame' glitches where the animation freezes momentarily before jumping forward. The roughness comes from unpredictability - smooth sections suddenly interrupted by harsh digital artifacts.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Create three duplicate layers per word using BaseLayout with position:'absolute' for RGB channel separation. Main container uses containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full bg-black'. Each word gets three TextAtom instances with different color channels (red, green, blue via CSS filters). Effects: Primary glitch effect uses rapid translateX animations with random ranges from -100 to 100 pixels, duration 0.1-0.3s, easing:'steps(4)' for digital stepping. RGB separation via translateX offsets: red layer -2 to 2px, blue layer 2 to -2px, green stays center. Add opacity flickers (0 to 1) with random timing. Implement 'scan lines' using multiple thin BaseLayout divs with height:'2px' and animated translateX. Use CSS clip-path for slicing effects: 'polygon(0 20%, 100% 20%, 100% 80%, 0 80%)' with animated percentage values. Timing: Use random time offsets for each effect start (Math.random() * 0.5). Hold frames via duplicated keyframes at same progress value. Performance: Limit to 3 simultaneous effects per word. Use transform3d() for hardware acceleration. Tailwind: 'font-mono uppercase tracking-wider', apply 'mix-blend-screen' for RGB channels

prompts.prompt: Develop a brutal, industrial typokinetics preset that feels like text being processed through heavy machinery. Each word should appear to be stamped, crushed, and hammered into place with mechanical violence. Think of a massive hydraulic press slamming down on each letter, causing vibrations that ripple through neighboring text. The animation should have weight and impact - text doesn't just appear, it crashes into existence with dust particles and shockwaves. Implement a 'metal fatigue' effect where text appears to bend and warp under pressure before snapping into place. Add subtle cracks and stress fractures that appear in the text surface through animated text-decoration and border effects. Include environmental shake where the entire composition trembles from the impact of each word landing. The rough texture comes from industrial grit - imagine text covered in rust, oil, and metal shavings.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center p-8'. Each word in separate BaseLayout with overflow:'visible' for impact effects. Create impact particles using multiple small ShapeAtom elements positioned absolutely around each word. Effects: Main slam effect - scale from 3.0 to 1.0 with ease-out-bounce, duration 0.4s. Add squash-and-stretch: scaleY animates from 0.3 to 1.2 to 1.0. Vibration aftershock: translateY oscillates ±5px with decreasing amplitude over 0.5s. Environmental shake on parent container: translateX/Y ±10px triggered by each word impact. Texture effects via CSS filters: contrast(1.5) brightness(0.8) sepia(0.2) for industrial look. Add text-shadow with multiple layers for depth: '2px 2px 0 #000, 4px 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'. Particles use translateY from -50px to 200px with opacity fade. Timing: Stagger each word by 0.2s. Impact occurs at relative 0, vibration continues for 1s. Performance: Use transform-origin: center bottom for realistic impact physics. Batch DOM updates for particles. Tailwind: 'font-black text-7xl text-zinc-300 uppercase tracking-tight'

prompts.prompt: Create a frenetic, ADHD-inspired typokinetics preset where text has zero attention span and constantly shifts between different animation styles. Each word should feel hyperactive and unable to sit still - bouncing, spinning, scaling, and jittering in rapid succession. Think of text with too much caffeine, constantly switching between different nervous tics. Implement at least 5 different micro-animations that randomly trigger: nervous twitch (quick rotation), anxious pulse (scale breathing), restless slide (horizontal drift), fidget spin (full rotation), and panic shake (all axes). The key is overlapping these behaviors so text never has a moment of rest. Add random 'hyperfocus' moments where a word suddenly becomes still and sharp while everything else continues moving. Include subtle ADHD visual metaphors like text briefly splitting into multiple copies (racing thoughts) or becoming blurry (loss of focus).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout grid with containerProps.className='grid grid-cols-auto gap-2 p-4'. Each word wrapped in BaseLayout with position:'relative' for local transform origin. Create thought bubble duplicates using position:'absolute' cloned TextAtoms with opacity:0.3. Effects: Layer 5 concurrent micro-animations per word - 1) Twitch: rotate ±3deg, duration:0.1s, random trigger times 2) Pulse: scale 0.95-1.05, duration:0.4s, ease-in-out, continuous loop 3) Drift: translateX ±10px, duration:2s, ease-in-out, continuous 4) Spin: rotate 360deg, duration:0.8s, random occurrence 5) Shake: translateX/Y ±2px, duration:0.05s, 20 keyframes. Hyperfocus effect: suddenly set all transforms to none, increase contrast filter to 2.0, duration:0.3s. Thought splitting: create 2-3 absolute clones that animate outward with opacity fade. Timing: Each effect has independent timing with Math.random() delays between 0-1s. Overlap factor of 0.7 (effects can stack). Performance: Use CSS containment: 'layout style paint'. Limit active effects to 3 per word using effect queue. Tailwind: 'font-bold text-5xl text-indigo-600 selection:bg-yellow-300'

prompts.prompt: Build a savage, primal typokinetics preset that feels like text is being carved into stone by an angry god. The animation should be violent and destructive - text appears through explosive fragmentation, as if being blasted out of rock. Each letter should crack and splinter into existence with debris flying outward. Implement a 'chisel strike' effect where text is revealed through multiple harsh impacts, each removing a layer of obscurity. Add geological texture through animated cracks that spread across letters like fracturing stone. The shake isn't smooth - it's the jarring vibration of impact tools against hard surfaces. Include dust clouds and particle effects that obscure and reveal text in waves. The overall feeling should be archaeological - like discovering ancient text through violent excavation.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative bg-stone-900 overflow-hidden'. Create multiple layers per word: base text, crack overlay (SVG paths), dust particles (ShapeAtom). Use clip-path on TextAtom for progressive reveal. Effects: Chisel strike animation - clip-path reveals text in 3-4 harsh steps using polygon shapes. Each strike triggers: translateY -5px, scale 1.1, brightness flash to 1.5. Crack propagation using animated SVG stroke-dasharray from 0 to full length. Fragment particles: 10-15 small divs per word with random trajectories (translateX/Y ±100px, rotate ±180deg). Dust cloud: large semi-transparent div with scale from 0.5 to 2.0, opacity 0.8 to 0. Vibration: parent container translateX/Y ±8px with steps(3) easing for harsh stepping. Texture: CSS filter with contrast(1.3) brightness(0.9) blur(0.3px) for rough edges. Timing: Each chisel strike 0.2s apart, total reveal over 0.8s. Particles animate over 1s with varied delays. Performance: Use transform3d for particles. Batch particle creation. GPU-accelerate filters. Tailwind: 'font-black text-8xl text-stone-200 uppercase tracking-tighter drop-shadow-2xl'

prompts.prompt: Design a chaotic data-moshing typokinetics preset where text appears to be caught between multiple video codecs fighting for control. The animation should feel like competing compression algorithms are tearing the text apart pixel by pixel. Implement datamoshing effects where parts of previous frames persist and blend with current frames, creating temporal smearing. Words should occasionally 'leak' into each other through simulated motion vector errors. Add macro-blocking artifacts where text temporarily becomes low-resolution pixel blocks before snapping back to clarity. Include P-frame and I-frame simulation where text alternates between smooth motion and sudden resets. The shake comes from codec errors - sudden position jumps as if keyframes are missing or corrupted.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Create frame buffer system with 3-4 BaseLayout layers, each containing full text set with different time offsets. Use containerProps.style with mixBlendMode:'difference' or 'screen' for frame blending. Implement pixel grid overlay using CSS grid for macro-blocking effect. Effects: Datamosh smear - previous frame persists at 0.3 opacity with translateX offset based on 'motion vectors'. Macro-blocking via CSS image-rendering:'pixelated' with dynamic font-size reduction/restoration. P-frame simulation: smooth translateX/Y over 0.5s. I-frame reset: instant position jump with no transition. Motion vector errors: random translateX/Y jumps of ±30-50px with instant transition. Compression artifacts: periodic blur(4px) and contrast(0.5) to simulate quality loss. Add scanline interlacing effect using repeating linear-gradient background. Timing: P-frames for 0.5-1s, then I-frame reset. Datamosh trails persist for 0.3s. Random glitches every 0.2-0.8s. Performance: Limit frame buffer to 3 layers. Use CSS contain:'strict'. Hardware accelerate with translateZ(0). Tailwind: 'font-mono text-6xl text-green-400 bg-black subpixel-antialiased'

prompts.prompt: Create an earthquake-inspired typokinetics preset where text behaves like objects during seismic activity. The animation should simulate different earthquake waves - P-waves (compression), S-waves (shear), and surface waves (rolling). Each word should have mass and inertia, responding to tremors with realistic physics. Implement building sway where taller text (larger font sizes) has more dramatic movement with a pendulum effect. Add liquefaction effects where text temporarily loses its solid structure and ripples like liquid. Include aftershocks - smaller tremors that occur after the main shake sequence. The rough texture comes from structural damage - cracks appearing in letters, edges crumbling, and parts of text breaking off. Create a Richter scale intensity parameter that controls the violence of the shaking.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full' as ground plane. Each word in BaseLayout with transform-origin at bottom center for pendulum physics. Create debris particles using small ShapeAtom elements. Effects: P-wave - rapid translateX oscillation ±15px at 20Hz. S-wave - translateY wave motion with sine curve, amplitude 20px. Surface wave - combined rotateZ ±5deg with translateY for rolling motion. Building sway - rotate animation with angle proportional to font-size (larger = more sway). Pendulum physics: rotateZ with ease-in-out, period based on text height. Liquefaction - apply CSS filter blur(2px) with wave-like scaleY distortion. Aftershocks - reduced amplitude copies of main shake at 2s, 4s, 6s. Structural damage via text-decoration:'line-through' with animated width. Debris particles fall with translateY and rotate animations. Timing: Main quake 2-3s, aftershocks at 50%, 25%, 10% intensity. Stagger word animations by 0.05s for wave propagation. Performance: Use transform3d for all movements. Batch particle updates. CSS containment on container. Tailwind: 'font-bold text-7xl text-red-600 tracking-tight [text-shadow:2px_2px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]'

prompts.prompt: Develop a strobe-light typokinetics preset that simulates text under aggressive nightclub/rave lighting conditions. The animation should pulse violently with the rhythm, creating a disorienting stop-motion effect. Text should flash in and out of visibility with harsh contrast changes, position shifts between flashes creating the illusion of teleportation. Implement a 'broken strobe' effect where the flash rate becomes irregular, adding to the chaos. Add motion trails that persist briefly after each flash, creating ghostly after-images. Include color channel strobing where RGB values flash independently. The shake comes from the jarring nature of strobe lighting - positions appear to jump rather than animate smoothly. Create an overwhelming sensory experience with multiple overlapping strobe frequencies.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with black background, containerProps.className='bg-black relative overflow-hidden'. Create 3-5 duplicate text layers for motion trails with decreasing opacity. Add strobe flash overlay div covering entire container. Effects: Main strobe - opacity keyframes [0,1,1,0] with steps(2) timing, duration:0.1s, infinite loop. Position jump - translateX/Y random values between strobes, no transition (instant). Motion trails - 3 absolute clones at previous positions, opacity 0.5, 0.3, 0.1, fade over 0.2s. Color strobe - animate color through ['#FF0000', '#00FF00', '#0000FF', '#FFFFFF'] with steps timing. Broken strobe - randomly vary animation-duration between 0.05s-0.2s using JS. Flash overlay - white div with opacity 0→1→0, duration:0.05s, mix-blend-mode:'screen'. After-image effect using filter:invert(1) on alternate frames. Timing: Base strobe at 10-15Hz. Color changes at 5Hz. Position jumps every 2-3 strobes. Random timing variations ±30%. Performance: Use CSS will-change:opacity,transform. GPU-accelerate with transform3d. Limit trail layers to 3. Tailwind: 'font-black text-8xl text-white uppercase neon-glow [text-shadow:0_0_20px_currentColor]'

prompts.prompt: Build a tectonic-shift typokinetics preset where text appears to be riding on colliding continental plates. Words should grind against each other with geological violence, creating mountain ranges of overlapping letters and deep trenches where text disappears. Implement subduction zones where one word slides under another, and transform boundaries where text slides past horizontally with grinding friction. Add volcanic eruptions where individual letters explode upward with particle effects. The shake isn't uniform - it's the slow, powerful grinding punctuated by sudden catastrophic shifts. Include continental drift where the entire text slowly migrates while shaking. Create fault lines that appear between words, widening and closing with seismic activity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout as tectonic plate container with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-stone-800 to-stone-900'. Words grouped into 'plates' using nested BaseLayout divs. Create fault lines using absolutely positioned divs between word groups. Effects: Plate collision - translateX animations bringing words together, with scale compression on impact. Subduction - translateY with z-index changes, one word sliding under with rotateX for 3D effect. Transform boundary - parallel translateX in opposite directions with friction shake (translateY ±3px at 30Hz). Mountain building - scaleY increases to 1.5 on collision, with rotateX for 3D uplift. Volcanic eruption - sudden translateY -100px with particle ShapeAtoms exploding outward. Continental drift - slow parent container translateX over 10s while children shake. Fault lines - width animation from 0 to 20px with irregular timing. Grinding effect - rapid small translateX/Y oscillations during plate contact. Timing: Slow drift (10s+) with sudden shifts (0.5s) every 2-3s. Eruptions at random 3-5s intervals. Performance: Use transform3d for all plate movements. Batch particle creation. Container queries for responsive plate sizes. Tailwind: 'font-black text-6xl md:text-8xl text-amber-100 uppercase tracking-tighter [perspective:1000px]'

prompts.prompt: Design a combat-sports inspired typokinetics preset where text takes damage like a fighter in the ring. Each word should shake from impact trauma, showing visible damage accumulation through progressive distortion. Implement punch impacts where text recoils from invisible blows, with directional shake based on hit angle. Add a 'wobble recovery' where text tries to stabilize but struggles like a dazed fighter. Include swelling effects where parts of letters expand from damage, and cut effects where text appears to split or bleed. The animation should escalate - starting with jabs (small shakes) and building to haymakers (violent position changes). Create a combo system where multiple rapid hits cause exponentially worse shaking. Add a knockout effect where text finally collapses after taking too much damage.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout ring container with containerProps.className='relative flex flex-wrap gap-4 p-8'. Each word as a fighter with health state tracking. Create damage indicator overlays using semi-transparent colored divs. Effects: Jab impact - translateX ±10px with bounce-back, duration:0.15s. Hook impact - rotate ±8deg with translateX, curved motion path. Uppercut - translateY -20px then fall with gravity (ease-in). Wobble recovery - decreasing amplitude oscillation on all axes over 1s. Swelling - localized scaleX/Y to 1.2 on impact point using clip-path. Cut effect - red text-shadow '2px 2px 0 #ff0000' appearing progressively. Combo multiplier - each successive hit within 0.5s increases shake amplitude by 1.5x. Daze effect - continuous small random movements, blur(1px) filter. KO sequence - rotate to 90deg while translateY to bottom, opacity fade. Damage accumulation - permanent slight rotation/position offset after each hit. Timing: Jabs every 0.3-0.5s, power shots every 1-2s. Combo window 0.5s. KO after 10-15 hits. Performance: Track damage state in CSS variables. Use transform-origin for realistic rotation. GPU-accelerate all transforms. Tailwind: 'font-black text-7xl text-red-600 italic uppercase [text-shadow:4px_4px_0_#000]'
